claim_boundary: Mathematical constitution and relational enhancement only; no physical universe yet.

CIF.obligation: Provide candidate classes and admitted modal possibility without actualizing them.

QV.obligation: Apply lawful compression/selection/crossing only with a local witness.

RFL.obligation: Store admitted output, lineage, route class, and return-memory identity.

kernel.expression: K_A(xi)=Sum_{j=1}^{n_c} delta^(-j) f_j(xi) Exp[-alpha j xi]

coordinate.meaning: dimensionless prephysical recursion evaluation coordinate; not physical time

kernel.normalized_weight_expression: p_j(xi;n)=delta^(-j) Exp[-alpha j xi] / Sum_{k=1}^{n} delta^(-k) Exp[-alpha k xi]

basis_admission_rule.candidate: A domain-labelled modal basis F_m={f_{m,j}} is eligible only when every component is typed, bounded, provenance-addressed, dimension/frame declared, and carries a preregistered witness/falsifier record.
basis_admission_rule.selection: QV admits an eligible basis only if all frozen predicates pass. Domain semantics and laws are not supplied by Module A and must be derived downstream.
basis_admission_rule.stabilization: RFL stores the admitted basis identity and provenance hash without identifying the returned RFL object with a new CIF object.

route_classes.GAUGE_EQUIVALENT: distinct representatives, same witnessed valid closure
route_classes.MULTI_ROUTE_VALID: distinct witnessed valid closures for the same admitted problem; retained as route strength/capacity
route_classes.EVENT_BRANCH_FAMILY: tied lawful branches retained without arbitrary label selection

relational_carrier.new_solution_rule: Lane growth alone never proves a new solution. A new closure requires a witnessed, admissible, non-gauge-equivalent closure distinction.

memory_reopening.no_loss_rule: A quotient may remove duplicate representatives only; it may not delete an independent source, phase/type, witness, invariant, branch, route, memory, or kernel distinction.
memory_reopening.promotion: An admitted RFL output may seed a later CIF candidate envelope only through an explicit promotion record retaining the RFL content hash and ancestry.
memory_reopening.non_identity: RFL_s is not identical to CIF_{s+1}; promotion is a typed map with preserved lineage.
memory_reopening.reopening: A closed object reopens only through a new witnessed event/condition; ancestor hashes and prior closure status remain immutable.

unbounded_manifestation_construct.family: For each m>=1, q_m=m/(m+1) and f_{m,j}=q_m^j e_{1+((j+m-2) mod 3)} defines a distinct bounded typed modal basis under the same source kernel.
unbounded_manifestation_construct.scope: This constructs unbounded lawful modal-basis capacity only. It does not assert identical equations, physical realization, empirical truth, or completed downstream laws.

source_precision.interpretation: decimal representation envelope only, not empirical uncertainty
